name: PT Natura City Developments Tbk
summary: PT Natura City Developments Tbk operates as a real estate in Indonesia. The company develops Serpong Natura City, a residential area covering approximately 210 ha. It also provides central business district, food court, market, commercial area, club house, and international school facilities. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Bogor, Indonesia. PT Natura City Developments Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Sentul City Tbk.
